action_summary: Restored the proven 5-fold BERT-large ensemble that produced the best score (v21, 0.36763) instead of the single fold4 model used in v22 (0.35115). Folds are now loaded and predicted one at a time with the model deleted and the CUDA cache emptied between folds to avoid GPU memory issues. Because the metric is Spearman, the fold predictions are combined by averaging per-column ranks (rescaled to [0,1]) with a small 10% blend of the raw probability mean as a tie-breaker, and clipped to [0,1]. Also hoisted the tokenizer construction out of the per-example loop (speed only, no change to outputs). The untested quantile discretization block remains disabled.
